effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[End of Your Turn] If you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon with the [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait attacks a player.
